title: Are you cutting more spending amid ongoing high gas prices? Share your story | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

High gas prices continue to weigh on Americans, forcing some to cut back on their spending this summer.

Although Trump administration officials promised that the spike in gas prices would subside, the cost remains far higher than it was when the US-Iran conflict began in late February.

Are you taking additional steps to curtail your spending as gas prices remain high? Have you had to cancel or modify summer travel plans?
